items.title: CLARITY Act's delay is 'depressing': Coinbase exec. discusses
items.summary: Coinbase's (COIN) head of institutional strategy, John D'Agostino, joins Yahoo Executive Editor Brian Sozzi on Opening Bid to discuss the stalled CLARITY Act, why the legislation matters for the crypto industry, and the growing role of stablecoins. D'Agostino also states that political stalling is holding up the bill, and why the delay is "depressing."

items.title: 3 Internet Stocks to Keep an Eye On
items.summary: Whether it be online shopping or social media, secular forces are propelling consumer internet businesses forward. The new habits they’re cultivating are also unlocking the next leg of growth for the industry, which has gained 11.8% over the past six months, almost identical to the S&P 500.

items.title: Coinbase Global (COIN) Will Attend A White House Crypto Summit
items.summary: Coinbase Global (NasdaqGS:COIN) executives are set to join U.S. regulators and Ripple leaders at a White House crypto summit, highlighting direct policy engagement at the federal level. The summit will include participation from key agencies such as the SEC and CFTC, with crypto regulation and industry input expected to be central topics. items.title: How the UAE has emerged as a ‘leading light’ for tokenization
items.summary: Coinbase's decision to base its global tokenization hub in Abu Dhabi is the latest sign that the emirate's bet on regulated digital assets is paying off—with $500 billion in GCC assets predicted to move onto blockchain by 2030.

items.title: Why the Crypto Industry Is More Reliant Than Ever on Trump
items.summary: Leaders of tech and crypto firms, including Coinbase and Ripple, plan to meet with President Donald Trump on Wednesday. It’s the next move for the executives with an industry friendly bill stalled.
